oracleAssessment.d1Retention: PASS: saved file survives failed indexing; actual linked importer completes copy and cancelled job leaves copy plus retry
oracleAssessment.originAndAlias: PASS: content-only document has no aliases; two distinct lexical paths resolve to one canonical target and persist under a stable document ID after a fresh SQLite reopen
oracleAssessment.workerStatusCancel: PASS: real owner worker reports active indexing and handles status plus targeted cancellation before bounded fixture work finishes
oracleAssessment.markersAndRedaction: PASS: ten scenario markers are emitted after their assertions; evidence contains IDs, counts, hashes, revisions, statuses, fixture basename and Node ABI without raw absolute source or store paths
